reviews.t: Not worth the few pennies saved
reviews.x: I tried the Element Six glycerin, to save a few pennies. I normally use Essential Depot glycerin, and I could taste the difference immediately. Essential Six seems to be of lower quality; not as sweet, and has an "odd" taste to it, when compared to Essential Depot. Even mixing them doesn't hide the taste.

This bottle will last me forever. I used it to add more moisture to my conditioner, as a base for a leave in spray, and as the base to a big bite spray.  Does it's job. Just know that using too much will leave a stickiness. Balance it with water and you're good to go.

reviews.t: Thickest, richest, and cloudiest I've found :)
reviews.x: For a while now, this is the only VG I use for my ejuice. I've used other types, but this is thick, rich, and puts out beautiful clouds. Carries flavor well too. Even though it's super thick, it mixes very well. No need to heat it or anything like that. Just pour it in the bottle with your flavoring and nic, and shake it up. Most flavors fully steep in this VG within a few days at most. Can't go wrong with this VG.

reviews.t: great quality and enough for more than 2 years
reviews.x: I use this to mix ejuice, great quality and enough for more than 2 years :). I decided to get this bigger bottle and saved a lot more compared to smaller bottles. As far as I know PG and VG are safe for long periods of time put in a dark place at room temperature, around 70. It's the ejuice concentrated flavors and Nic that you don't want more than a 6 month supply to store.

That makes it possible for them to chase & catch the bubbles and that makes them happy.  Worth it.

No strange taste to speak of, bottle arrived free of leaks, ready to compound my vapor liquids into the finest flavors. Might even use for glycerites in the future for more herbal persuits. Definitely a solid purchase.

Reviewers frequently highlight the good price and value for the amount received.
Several customers use it for homemade soaps, body wash, and skin/hand care, noting it helps with dry, cracked hands.
Some reviewers note it can leave a stickiness if too much is used, so it should be balanced with water.
